The idea · हरा भारत

A greener India isn't planted in one day. It's grown at home, one balcony, one terrace, one family at a time. The ride carries that message from Indore across the country, and brings it back home.

01PeopleChange happens when people take part, not when they're told.

03SoilHealthy soil is where every green city starts.

Questions

Before you
book.

When do slots open, and when does the convoy leave?

Rider onboarding opens across India on 19 November 2026 with the launch and flag-off at Green House, Indore. Until the convoy departs, NMT promotion rides go out across Indore every day. Exact departure details are shared in your rider briefing.

Who can join?

Anybody with a road-legal motorcycle or car, a valid licence and insurance. Families, colleges, schools, corporates, hospitality teams, growers and creators can join the movement too.

How are convoy spots allotted?

In booking order. The earlier you book, the further up the convoy you ride. Cars ride in the left lane, bikes in the right.

What does the ₹50,000 onboarding include?

Your rider badge, the NMT Home Kit, priority access across the route, your convoy spot, daily promotion rides in Indore before departure, a participation certificate and access to the Green Mission India network.

Is the ride sponsored?

No. NMT Green Ride is funded by the people who join it. The aim is to help make Indore one of India's greenest cities.

What do I wear?

White top and blue jeans. Protective riding gear is mandatory for every rider.
